installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Initial install script with optional DepotDownloader method
# Server Files: /mnt/server

set -euo pipefail

SRCDS_APPID=258550

# set -u must not abort when these are unset
STEAM_PASS="${STEAM_PASS:-}"
STEAM_AUTH="${STEAM_AUTH:-}"
EXTRA_FLAGS="${EXTRA_FLAGS:-}"

# Resolve download method (supports both DOWNLOAD_METHOD and download_method)
DOWNLOAD_METHOD="${DOWNLOAD_METHOD:-${download_method:-SteamCMD}}"
METHOD_LC="$(echo "${DOWNLOAD_METHOD}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"

# Resolve branch from FRAMEWORK
# public | aux01 | aux02 | staging (default: public)
FRAMEWORK="${FRAMEWORK:-public}"
case "$(echo "${FRAMEWORK}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in
  *aux1*)    BRANCH="aux01" ;;
  *aux2*)    BRANCH="aux02" ;;
  *staging*) BRANCH="staging" ;;
  *)         BRANCH="public" ;;
esac

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [ "${STEAM_USER:-}" == "" ]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set."
    echo -e "Using anonymous user."
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

# A failed unzip install must not abort before steamcmd is created.
install_unzip() {
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    return 0
  fi
  echo "Installing unzip..."
  if apt-get update && apt-get install -y unzip; then
    return 0
  fi
  echo "apt unzip failed; retrying bullseye from archive.debian.org..."
  if [ -f /etc/os-release ] && grep -q bullseye /etc/os-release; then
    printf 'Acquire::Check-Valid-Until "false";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99no-check-valid-until
    if [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list ]; then
      sed -i \
        -e 's|http://deb.debian.org/debian-security|http://archive.debian.org/debian-security|g' \
        -e 's|http://security.debian.org/debian-security|http://archive.debian.org/debian-security|g' \
        -e 's|http://deb.debian.org/debian|http://archive.debian.org/debian|g' \
        /etc/apt/sources.list || true
    fi
    if apt-get update && apt-get install -y unzip; then
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "unzip is still missing; python3 will extract DepotDownloader zips."
    return 0
  fi
  echo "unzip is unavailable; continuing so steamcmd can still be installed."
  return 0
}
install_unzip || true

extract_zip() {
  local zip="$1"
  local dest="$2"
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    unzip -o "${zip}" -d "${dest}"
    return
  fi
  if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    python3 -c 'import sys, zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]).extractall(sys.argv[2])' "${zip}" "${dest}"
    return
  fi
  echo "Cannot extract ${zip}: unzip and python3 are missing."
  return 1
}

install_depotdownloader() {
  local dd_dir="/mnt/server/DepotDownloader"
  local zip="/tmp/DepotDownloader.zip"
  # Pinned release; override with DEPOTDOWNLOADER_URL if needed
  local url="${DEPOTDOWNLOADER_URL:-https://github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader/releases/download/DepotDownloader_3.4.0/DepotDownloader-linux-x64.zip}"

  if [ -x "${dd_dir}/DepotDownloader" ]; then
    echo "DepotDownloader already installed."
    return 0
  fi

  echo "Downloading DepotDownloader..."
  mkdir -p "${dd_dir}"
  curl -sSL -o "${zip}" "${url}"
  extract_zip "${zip}" "${dd_dir}"
  chmod +x "${dd_dir}/DepotDownloader" || true
  rm -f "${zip}"
}

## download and install steamcmd (for libs and/or SteamCMD method)
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
chmod 755 /mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# Only the server volume is writable. /mnt/install is a read-only Wings mount.
chown -R root:root /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server

# Bootstrap SteamCMD so linux32/linux64 exist for both download methods.
./steamcmd.sh +quit || true

# If DepotDownloader method selected, install and use it for server files
if [ "${METHOD_LC}" = "depotdownloader" ] || [ "${METHOD_LC}" = "dd" ]; then
  echo "Using DepotDownloader to download server files (anonymous)..."
  install_depotdownloader
  /mnt/server/DepotDownloader/DepotDownloader -app "${SRCDS_APPID}" -dir /mnt/server -branch "${BRANCH}" -validate
else
  echo "Using SteamCMD to download server files (anonymous/default)..."
  if [ -n "${STEAM_PASS}" ]; then
  if [ -n "${STEAM_AUTH}" ]; then
    ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" "${STEAM_AUTH}" +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit
  else
    ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit
  fi
else
  ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} ${EXTRA_FLAGS} validate +quit
fi
fi

# Executable bits before later steps that can abort.
if [ -f /mnt/server/RustDedicated ]; then chmod 755 /mnt/server/RustDedicated; fi
if [ -f /mnt/server/runds.sh ]; then chmod 755 /mnt/server/runds.sh; fi

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
if [ -f /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so ]; then
  cp -v /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
fi

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
if [ -f /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so ]; then
  cp -v /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
fi

variables.description: The name of your server in the public server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description under your server title. Commonly used for rules & info. Use \n for newlines.

variables.name: URL
variables.description: The URL for your server. This is what comes up when clicking the "Visit Website" button.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum amount of players allowed in the server at once.

variables.name: Server Image
variables.description: The header image for the top of your server listing.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Port for RCON connections.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: RCON access password. Using a weak password will cause the server to not start. Set a strong password. You can generate a strong password here: https://randomkeygen.com/

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: Sets the server’s auto-save interval in seconds.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Add additional startup parameters to the server.

variables.name: App Port
variables.description: Port for the Rust+ App. -1 to disable.

variables.name: Server Logo
variables.description: The circular server logo for the Rust+ app.

variables.name: Custom Map URL
variables.description: Overwrites the map with the one from the direct download URL. Invalid URLs will cause the server to crash.

variables.name: Level
variables.description: The world file for Rust to use.

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: The world size for a procedural map.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: The seed for a procedural map.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Server Query Port. Can't be the same as Game's primary port.

variables.name: Modding Framework
variables.description:
The modding framework to be used: carbon, oxide, vanilla.
Defaults to "vanilla" for a non-modded server installation.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Choose which beta version to use for your server. Public is the current version of Rust and should be used for live servers unless you're running a staging server of some sort.

variables.name: Download Method
variables.description: Choose your preferred way of downloading and validating server files.

variables.name: Modding Root Directory
variables.description: The root directory of your modding framework - If using carbon, this should be set to carbon. If using oxide, this should've set to oxide.

variables.name: Server Identity
variables.description: The directory of your server. Default is set to rust.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Determines if the server with automatically update on start.

variables.name: Chaos Code Extension
variables.description: Download and use the ChaosCode extension?

variables.name: Discord Extension
variables.description: Download and use the Discord Extension?

variables.name: RustEdit Extension
variables.description: Download and install the RustEdit Extension?

variables.name: Validate Game Files
variables.description: Determine if you want the server to validate the game files every time the server starts.

variables.description: Unless you know what you're doing, leave this field blank. This is very important! Please do not change this unless you have read the Rust+ App documentation here: https://wiki.facepunch.com/rust/rust-companion-server

variables.name: Framework Update
variables.description: Disable installation / update of any chosen framework.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Gamemode of Rust - Choose between none (default),vanilla,survival,softcore,hardcore

variables.name: Log File Location
variables.description: Timestamped copy of the panel console. The live console is not timestamped. Leave blank to disable. A $(date +...) token in the path is expanded once when the container starts.

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Do you want to enable the egg's debug mode?

variables.name: Mono Logging
variables.description: Outputs all mono logs to a file. This is a developer only tool to troubleshoot and should not be ran in a production server. Outputs are logged into mono-debug.log as well as the Pterodactyl terminal.
